descriptions.d17c_trail_init_801222cc: Store the even trail kind and point count, load the by-value named mesh into +100 (destroying the name at exit), clear its +88 virtual flag and retain its shape at +56; load "ShortTrail" (kind 2) or "Trail" into +104, for "Trail" clearing the 40-byte segment block and resetting each point's age, point, edge and normal vectors to zero; record owner, head 0 and style kind + 15.
